headline.text: L1 Sollich 4 lost *2.5 hours* to a pump coupling failure and torn valve — both cleared by 19:03, but 3rd shift was already canceled.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 3 ran Labeler B only after label material defects sidelined Labeler A all day — QA accepted minor bubbles at 16:16. Sollich 4 lost 2.5 hours to a pump coupling failure and a torn valve gasket, both fixed by 19:03. Sollich 2 canceled a Tate's run when chocolate drums arrived too solid to use and pivoted to a level 4 clean. Sollich 1 saw recurring belt threads near the tunnel; maintenance trimmed loose pieces and the team is monitoring with extra eyes.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML3 had three brief stoppages — sensor alignment at 17:01, two label breaks, and a vibrator fault at 19:17 all cleared inside 10 minutes. ML2 branch pump increased to 50% at 16:10 to prevent hopper pausing, running well since. VFFS basket #5 and X-ray recipe both needed quick fixes mid-shift. Hershey Peco pallet delivery arrived late at 16:55 but covered the week.
per_plant_summary.L3: Truffle Line bottomer wire mesh tore at 19:50, repaired by 07:33, broke again during adjustment at 07:36, final fix at 11:09. ML1 completed a level 2 clean with ATP pass at 07:24 and cleared four quick mechanical issues overnight — rotary valve air hose, C6 dirty rollers, aligning belt, and M220 belt height. MF Matrix finished a changeover to assorted 1/4 pallets by 13:33.

notes.text: Four chocolate drums sent from L1 to L3 warm room at 10:39 to be held through the weekend for rescheduled Tate's run (~Oct 6).
Warm room ramped to 113°F overnight for L1 chocolate barrels, returned to 100–103°F at 08:06.

resolved.title: Sollich 3 Labeler A down on label material defect
resolved.summary: Pecan MMK labels had ridges and bubbles across multiple lot codes; team tested three lots, all showed wrinkles or ridges, determined vendor material issue.
resolved.resolution: QA accepted small bubbles and wrinkles outside main display panel at 16:16; line ran on Labeler B only for remainder of shift.

resolved.title: Sollich 4 Conbar pump coupling broken
resolved.summary: Caramel pump stopped transferring to Conbar at 14:38; maintenance found coupling between motor and pump damaged.
resolved.resolution: Coupling repaired, caramel flowing again at 15:21 — "Sollich 4 is running again" (S4 Kitchen Tablet).

resolved.title: Sollich 4 valve gasket ripped during run
resolved.summary: Damaged valve discovered at 16:05; line stopped, caramel drained, and crew began cleaning while waiting on part.
resolved.resolution: Gasket replaced by 19:03; caustic clean completed by 22:51 (3rd shift not running for unrelated scheduling reasons).

resolved.title: Fructose (10268) delivery delayed for SOL 4 Kitchen
resolved.summary: Had 540 lbs on hand (enough for today), needed more for Monday 2nd shift; 6,750 lb shipment arrived Springville at 10:00 but not in system.
resolved.resolution: Received in system at 15:53, CoA cleared at 16:24 — "CoA had been received" (Nisheena Etcitty).

resolved.title: Sollich 3 C1 belt pausing intermittently
resolved.summary: Belt paused multiple times; line stopped <5 minutes at 13:29 to allow maintenance reset.

resolved.title: ML3 sensor misalignment stopping line
resolved.summary: Line down at 17:01; maintenance worked on aligning sensors.

resolved.title: ML3 vertical vibrator overheating fault
resolved.summary: Line down 5 minutes at 19:17; fault code indicated vibrator overheating, but product quality remained good.
resolved.resolution: Raymond Fleming turned off horizontal vibrator (not needed); fault cleared at 19:28, chocolate quality unchanged.

resolved.title: Hershey Peco pallet delivery delayed
resolved.summary: Today's delivery missing; had 250 pallets on hand, needed 118 to finish week, another delivery scheduled Monday.
resolved.resolution: Delivery arrived at 16:55 — "PECO pallets Hershey's arrived at L2" (Jovani Castellanos).

resolved.title: VFFS basket #5 not working
resolved.summary: Basket #5 stopped functioning at 14:26; maintenance called.

resolved.title: VFFS X-ray rejecting excess bags
resolved.summary: X-ray over-rejecting good product at 14:31; maintenance reconfigured recipe settings.

resolved.title: ML2 branch pump not keeping hopper full
resolved.summary: Hopper running low and pausing; Alan increased branch pump from default to 50% at 16:10 and ran capture test.
resolved.resolution: Pump adjustment successful — "no issues with the hopper running empty" as of 20:54 (Brandon Lance).

resolved.title: ML3 label breaks on roll change (2 instances)
resolved.summary: Label broke during roll change at 17:31 and again at 20:22; brief stoppages each time.
resolved.resolution: Both breaks cleared quickly — 17:34 and 20:26 respectively.

resolved.title: Truffle Line bottomer wire mesh damaged twice
resolved.summary: Wire mesh torn at 19:50, maintenance called; repaired by 07:33 but north end broke again during slight adjustment at 07:36.
resolved.resolution: Spencer completed final repair at 11:09 — "Yes. Spencer Andrus just got done with the repair" (Itzel Chavez).

resolved.title: ML1 M220 belt dragging on C2 belt
resolved.summary: Sideways belt M220 positioned too low at 11:44, dragging onto belt C2 and causing damage.
resolved.resolution: Raised slightly to prevent further damage.

resolved.title: ML1 aligning belt dropping chocolates underneath
resolved.summary: Chocolates going under aligning belt at 21:29; maintenance notified.

resolved.title: ML1 right rotary valve not working
resolved.summary: Right side rotary valve stopped at 23:21; maintenance on-site.
resolved.resolution: One air hose unplugged from fitting, reconnected at 23:27 — "just We put back in" (Jose Vasquez).

resolved.title: ML1 C6 belt tracking side to side
resolved.summary: C6 belt moving erratically at 00:46; inspection found dirty rollers.
resolved.resolution: Rollers cleaned, line running at 01:04 — "ML1 it is already running."

needs_attention.title: Sollich 3 C1 kettle discharge valve failing
needs_attention.summary: Valve has 16-second delay before opening when screen shows green (open); operator Donato reported at 13:52, may be progressively worsening.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance notified; Chris Jeffs confirmed part not in stock at 14:12, requesting quote now.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 1 belt fraying near tunnel 1
needs_attention.summary: Operators found belt material (threads, pieces) by tunnel 1 at 15:25 and again at 17:13; belt not severely fraying but shedding small pieces.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance trimmed loose pieces at 17:36; running with 3 EEs at depositor and 2 before enrober monitoring closely; QA watching as well. 3rd shift scheduled to replace belt tonight or over weekend.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 3 corn syrup hose leaking
needs_attention.summary: Kitchen 3 operator noticed corn syrup hose leak at 04:52; maintenance checking for replacement hose availability.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance notified as of 04:52, no update posted on part availability or repair.

needs_attention.title: MF Matrix sensor fault causing pause
needs_attention.summary: Line paused at 19:40 due to sensor fault during 2nd shift run.
needs_attention.status: Pause reported at 19:40; no clear resolution or restart message posted.

needs_attention.title: ML1 C2 belt has cut running throughout
needs_attention.summary: Belt C2 discovered with a cut running the length of the belt at 07:08 during post-clean inspection.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 07:08 with photo; no follow-up on replacement or repair plan.
